summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Riskified Ltd. furnishing the notice and proxy statement for its annual general meeting of shareholders. The meeting will be held on August 6, 2026, to re-elect three Class II directors and re-appoint the independent auditor. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation is implicated. The filing is purely a governance and administrative update, not an event-driven special situation.
